channel.title: ArcheAge Chronicles Wiki
channel.description: An unofficial player-made guide for ArcheAge Chronicles: the four launch classes, weapon mastery, respec mechanics and the launch-day route — verified against official class introductions and dated.

item.title: ArcheAge Chronicles Berserker Guide — Axe & Shield, Warhammer Builds
item.description: The ArcheAge Chronicles Berserker: Axe and Shield tanking at 10/10, the fixed Warhammer, named skills, and the three community builds. Dated.

item.title: ArcheAge Chronicles Mage Guide — Elemental Staff & Wavesword
item.description: The ArcheAge Chronicles Mage: Elemental Staff area damage, the wavesword melee cast, AoE clear and zone control builds. Dated.

item.title: ArcheAge Chronicles Ranger Guide — Hatchet & Longbow Builds
item.description: The ArcheAge Chronicles Ranger: Hatchet melee or longbow kiting, the best all-rounder scores in the game, and the best solo farmer. Dated.

item.title: ArcheAge Chronicles Tier List — Best Classes & Weapons (Early Access)
item.description: Community tier scores for all 12 ArcheAge Chronicles weapons — PvE and PvP — with quick picks by playstyle and live-meta caveats. Dated.

item.title: ArcheAge Chronicles Warrior Guide — Longsword, Greatsword & the Gladius
item.description: The ArcheAge Chronicles Warrior: parry-and-counter melee with longsword or greatsword, PvP tier standing, and the December Gladius. Dated.

item.title: ArcheAge Chronicles Known Issues — Launch Bugs, Fixes & Patch Status
item.description: ArcheAge Chronicles launch bugs with live status: tutorial fix deployed November 4, boss despawn partially fixed, Malchuk still under investigation. Dated.

item.title: ArcheAge Chronicles Launch-Day Guide — Your First Hours
item.description: Launch-day route for ArcheAge Chronicles: unlock times, first weapon, the Q weapon swap, level-25 build lock, and launch-week issues. Verified and dated.
